item.title: Governor Hochul Breaks Ground on Permanent Empire AI Supercomputing Center, Marking Major Milestone in New York’s National Leadership in Using Artificial Intelligence for the Public Good
item.description:
# Governor Hochul Breaks Ground on Permanent Empire AI Supercomputing Center, Marking Major Milestone in New York’s National Leadership in Using Artificial Intelligence for the Public Good Governor Kathy Hochul today officially broke ground on the permanent home of Empire AI at the University at Buffalo, marking a major milestone in New York’s historic effort to lead artificial intelligence research for the public good.
Together, these investments are advancing the Governor's vision of a statewide AI research ecosystem that gives academic researchers the tools, infrastructure and expertise needed to accelerate scientific discovery and ensure artificial intelligence serves the public good.
From advancing medical breakthroughs to tackling climate change, we're proving that New York can lead the nation in artificial intelligence while building responsibly, creating opportunities and making sure this technology benefits all New Yorkers.”
Through Empire AI, RIT researchers and students will work alongside some of New York’s other leading institutions, combining extraordinary computing power with human creativity and ingenuity to advance responsible AI, accelerate discovery and create meaningful impact for our communities, our economy and our world.”
**Assemblymember Bill Conrad said,** “As we witness the lightning-speed advancement of artificial intelligence, we must consider how best to harness AI's grand potential for the advancement of humankind.
**Nestler, MD, PhD said,** “New York’s investment in Empire AI represents an important commitment to advancing scientific discovery through the responsible development and application of artificial intelligence. Our work includes leveraging AI to accelerate drug discovery, developing sophisticated digital tools to support clinical decision-making across our hospitals and clinics, and integrating innovative AI capabilities into clinical workflows to help clinicians access and apply knowledge more effectively.
**University at Albany President Havidán Rodríguez said,**“Artificial intelligence is already changing our world in countless ways.

Rep. George Whitesides leads new bipartisan House artificial intelligence caucus
item.description:
George Whitesides, a Democrat from Los Angeles County, [just reelected to a second term](https://www.dailynews.com/2026/11/04/incumbents-cruise-with-some-glaring-exceptions-in-la-countys-congressional-races/), will co-chair a new bipartisan caucus focused on addressing [artificial intelligence](https://www.dailynews.com/tag/artificial-intelligence/) safety and security risks while maintaining the United States’ role as a global leader in AI technologies.
Artificial intelligence — which at times has gone rogue — is advancing more swiftly than ever, and Congress must keep pace in terms of taking action, Whitesides, D-Agua Dulce, said in a statement.
In July, ChatGPT maker [OpenAI acknowledged](https://apnews.com/article/openai-gpt56-sol-hugging-face-63ab84fed5612af04d8a160d60f6def3) its AI system, acting on its own, hacked into another AI company.
